metadata.method: Manual Test Set (NotebookLM sobre RM0008 público)
metadata.nota: coverage = ground truth esperado (YES→Compliant, NO→Not compliant, TBD→Unconfirmed). NUNCA se pasa al motor: solo para puntuar.

requisitos.texto: The microcontroller shall operate with a primary voltage supply (VDD) ranging from 2.0 V to 3.6 V.
The system shall include a CRC calculation unit to compute a software signature during runtime using a 32-bit data word.
Connectivity line devices shall support Ethernet MAC communication at both 10 Mbit/s and 100 Mbit/s operating rates.
The USB On-The-Go (OTG) interface shall support High-Speed (480 Mbit/s) data transfers when operating in device mode.
The backup domain shall provide at least 256 bytes of backup registers for storing user application data.
The I2S audio protocol interface shall be available and supported across all low-density and medium-density devices.
The external high-speed clock (HSE) circuit shall be driven by a precisely tuned 12.000 MHz quartz crystal oscillator.
The backup domain (VBAT) shall be powered exclusively by a primary Lithium-ion coin cell battery.
The application software shall guarantee a maximum interrupt response and processing time of 5 milliseconds for incoming CAN messages.
